item.title: Google Releases Cogentic Papers on Integer Factorization, Discrete Logs and More
item.description:
📝 Cogentic Research Papers This directory holds research papers that were produced by Cogentic. Papers November 25, 2026 Unconditional Integer Factorization in Time L_N[1/3, O(1)] (PDF) Discrete Logarithms in Finite Fields of Fixed Characteristic in Sub-Quasi-Polynomial Time (PDF) An Exact Polynomial-Time Algorithm for 1/5-Approximate Nash Equilibria in Bimatrix Games (PDF) Unconditional Deterministic Subexponential Integer Factoring and Quadratic Nonresidue Construction (PDF) Breaking the Square-Root Barrier for the Log-Rank Conjecture (PDF) Unconditional Edge Reconstruction of Simple Graphs of Linear Density (PDF) November 23, 2026 Nearly Tight O(log log log m) Prophet Inequalities for Subadditive Combinatorial Auctions (PDF) Polynomial Dimension Dependence for Fictitious Play Convergence (PDF) November 18, 2026 Near-Quadratic Sample Compression for All VC Classes (PDF) October 30, 2026 Intractability of Approximate Correlated Equilibria in Two-Player Convex Games (PDF) License Unless otherwise noted in individual subdirectories, the contents in this directory are released under the Apache 2. Disclaimer: This is not an official Google product.

item.title: Taking over US Treasury subdomains for $3 each
item.description:
📝 With the quota increased, we ran a Python script to claim addresses with each cycle following this flow:Allocate 25 Elastic IPs in the current region. Release every address that didn’t match. This would force an attacker to create a whole new organization each time they’re banned, which is more effort.
